text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install cargo-spellcheck
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-spellcheck

      - name: Run spellcheck
        run: |
          cargo spellcheck --workspace --exclude "target/**" --exclude "src/**/*.rs"
```
